correctness.rationale: Let T be any finite simple unweighted tree with >=2 vertices. Exact expansion of R4(-hL) by graph distance gives h p_uv(h) on edges, h^3/6(1-h q(P)/4) for distance-three paths, strictly positive entries for distance two and four when h>0, zero past four, and positive diagonal by a sum-of-squares spectral identity. Edge p_uv=1-(a+b)h/2+[a²+ab+b²+a+b-1]h²/6-C_uv h³/24 with C_uv=(a+b)(a²+b²)+2(a²+ab+b²)-2(a+b)+s_u+s_v. Bound B<=(a+b)² and C>=(a+b)^3/2 force p' negative by negative derivative discriminant and unique positive root. Therefore entire entrywise positivity set is [0,min_uv root(p_uv),min_{length3 path} 4/sum degrees], with no reentry. Independent integer matrix powers on P5, subdivided star, P6, K2 checked all coefficient classes and the distinct first-failure mechanisms.
